description: A Swift client for the Spider transit API — plan trips, list a stop's next departures, and look up a single trip from your app.
rules: Construct one SpiderClient with your environment base URL and API key — SpiderClient(baseURL: "https://your-env-slug.api.tiducto.eu", apiKey: "...") — then reach a surface via client.routing, client.stops, or client.realtime.
Plan a trip with client.routing.plan(PlanOptions(origin:destination:first:)); build locations with .coordinate(lat, lon), and page results with client.routing.planNext(page) / planPrevious(page).
List a stop's upcoming departures with client.routing.departures(stopId, numberOfDepartures:), and fetch a single trip's timetable with client.routing.trip(tripId).

Every call returns a SpiderResult you branch on (.success / .failure) instead of throwing; the only thrown error is SpiderContractMismatchError, raised when the gateway speaks a different major contract version than this SDK.
